forbidden.rule: No claim about trading, investment or business performance, win rates, profits, track record or results, including backtests and historical figures presented as indicative of the future.
No claim or implication of returns, income, profit, yield or guaranteed outcomes.
Never state or imply that BluPin or any product is authorised, licensed, registered, regulated, approved or endorsed by any authority, unless the owner supplies the current reference and it is cited.
No number (users, assets, clients, percentages, ratings, years) without a cited, current source.
No statement of legal-entity details, registrations, addresses or ownership without an owner-supplied source.

experience_standards.expression: The five intended feelings are precision, confidence, discipline, performance and informed decision-making. Expression per interface is undecided until a product is identified.
No unsupported claims; see claims_policy. Limits and sources are stated wherever a figure appears.
A displayed figure is correct and sourced. Value is shown as a checkable result.
The accessibility baseline applies to any interface under this brand and outranks brand expression.

domain_overrides.reason: A confident, professional tone must never state or imply regulated status, advice or guaranteed outcomes. If any financial product is ever shown, regulatory constraints win.
A displayed figure must be correct and sourced; polish never outranks correctness.

unknowns.question: No shipping product with an audience has been identified under BluPin Incorporated. The signal engine that was once associated with the name was removed from Dot.Charts and its Brain wiring retired on 2026-10-16. Which products, if any, this brand will cover is undecided.
Who the audience is. Nothing is asserted.
Legal entity details, registrations and any authorisations are not recorded here. None may be claimed.

The brief lists "performance" among the intended feelings. This draft reads it as an experience quality (responsive, rigorous execution) and not as investment or business performance, which the claims policy forbids. The owner must confirm that reading.
brain.autonomy.md treats BluPin as a separate entity from Dot. Whether this brand shares any of the dot-ecosystem principles (and so should extend it) is undecided, so this profile extends nothing.
No behavioural or customer evidence exists. Every emotional_promise item is intended, not measured.

notes: Deliberately minimal: audience, positioning and visual direction are not invented.
